overview_description.description:
Volopay is a financial solution provider that offers corporate cards, automated expense management, and accounting integrations that streamline financial operations, helping businesses save time and money while elevating the role of their finance teams. 

We are obsessed with empowering finance teams, transforming them from simple bookkeepers into strategic assets within organizations. Aspiring to drive change across the APAC region, we aim to become the go-to financial partner for businesses seeking growth and efficiency.

identifier.value: Rajith Shaji Co-founder and CEO @ Volopay

about_short_description.short_description: Volopay simplifies business spending using corporate cards and automated payables.

product.name: Corporate Physical Cards
product.description: Physical VISA prepaid cards issued to employees for business expenses such as travel and client meetings, with built-in spending controls.

product.name: Corporate Virtual Cards
product.description: Unlimited virtual cards generated for online payments, SaaS subscriptions, and vendor payments with customizable spending rules.

product.name: Accounts Payable Automation
product.description: Automation tools to streamline invoice approvals, scheduling, recurring payments, and vendor management with multi-level approval workflows.

product.name: Employee Expense Reimbursement Software
product.description: A platform for employees to submit out-of-pocket expense claims in real-time via mobile or web app, with automated approvals and accounting integration.

identifier.value: Business Bank Account with Multi-Currency Payments

product.name: Business Bank Account with Multi-Currency Payments
product.description: A global business account supporting multi-currency wallets and domestic and international money transfers with SWIFT and non-SWIFT options.

product.name: Automated Accounting and Integrations
product.description: Automated syncing and classification of transactions with popular accounting software like QuickBooks, Xero, Netsuite, and MYOB.
